record.summary: The native-frame source-uncertainty pilot is terminal. All 200 rows regenerated with bit parity and exact per-row metered-FLOP equality; all ten channels live on every row. The widened pilot fit passed every validity conjunct (ratio to host 0.3505, 40/40 wins, maximum network 4.004550104523242e-8) but reached 3.1266471361078166e-8 versus the paired J-native pilot's 3.107235383605394e-8: a 0.6247% regression, so the preregistered scaling rule does not license full-688 continuation. The Q24 host's own approximation-quality observables carry no autonomous residual signal, resolving the frame ambiguity left by the Q closure. Across M (-0.008%), N (+0.104%), P (+0.011%), Q (+0.105%), and R (-0.625%), five materially different arms spanning operator classes and information supply in both frames bracket the residual-observer program at its information ceiling, while teacher forcing at 8.207963477637236e-9 keeps proving the recursion has capacity when the true state is supplied. Reaching raw 1e-8 requires improving the host itself.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed measured under its frozen pilot law: no channel-subset sweep, no second seed, no full-688 continuation. The sole licensed successor is the design-only host-error-mechanism localization P2R0F2S.
